title: tricholaena insularis
intro: Tricholaena insularis, commonly known as Island Tricoloma, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tricholaena insularis are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, as well as its capacity to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant are mainly flavonoids and phenolic compounds, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
